messages:
Elaine: Draft release notes + internal announcement for v1.9.0 are ready. Please quick-review copy and confirm change window. Draft link: https://internal.docs/release/v1.9.0
Raj: Looks good overall. tiny nit: call the feature 'reserved capacity' instead of 'dedicated capacity' in the bullets.
Jess: Can we add a one-liner about the new caching heuristic? Ops will want that in the notes.
Elaine: Added a short line about the caching heuristic. Suggested change window: Thu 2026-04-15 10:00-12:00 PDT (low traffic). Thoughts?
Nina: Oncall: that overlaps with our infra maintenance at 10:30. prefer 13:00-15:00 PDT.
Tim: 13:00-15:00 works for my team. Ops/SRE okay?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI: green. Tag created: release/1.9.0. Staging deploy started at 1825001500.
Raj: Also please include model pinning details in the notes — we're pinning `llama-2-13b-q4` and `rwd-infer-1` for Dedicated by default.
Elaine: Added a 'Model pinning' section with those two versions.
Marco: Rollout plan proposal: canary 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> full. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 1.5% above baseline.
Nina: I suggest lowering initial canary to 3% to be safe.
Elaine: Changed canary to 3%. Added rollback playbook link: https://internal.docs/playbooks/release-rollback.md
Jess: Wording tweak for internal announcement: say "we will enable a new cost-optimization caching heuristic" rather than "we shipped caching" — less traffic-facing.
Elaine: Done. Final asks: who will post the internal announcement? I'll schedule the message but need legal to sign off on the compliance blurb.
Tim: @Olivia from Legal — can someone ping her for sign-off?
Olivia: Olivia: I can sign off by EOD tomorrow. Please add the data-retention bullet and I'll ack.
Elaine: :thumbsup: Added retention line. Final checklist in the draft: release notes link, pinned model versions, canary plan (3% first), rollback link, change window 13:00-15:00 PDT, legal sign-off. Planning to post at 09:00 tomorrow unless someone objects.
Raj: Add a line about the Dedicated capacity SLA bump for enterprise customers.
Elaine: Added SLA bullet. Ready to post.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled for 2026-04-15T20:00Z (13:00 PDT). Canary config: ```canary: - 3% for 15m - 25% for 30m - 100%``` Auto-rollback condition: 5xx_rate > 1.5% over baseline.
Nina: Oncall ack. I'll monitor error rates & p50/p90 latency dashboards during rollout.
Tim: I'll publish the internal announcement and ping Olivia once posted. Copy below will be the channel post.
Elaine: Thanks all — final draft pushed to https://internal.docs/release/v1.9.0. Closing thread."
